args.message: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the tests (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.66` as expected.

CI: passed (ci-0001)

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and tests (per FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- **Fix:** Changed `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` on branch `fix/bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — it passed.
- **PR:** Opened [pull request #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with alex requested as reviewer.
